SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT PORS.BUYER , PORS.PO_NO , PORS.PO_SEQ , PORS.DS_SEQ , PORS.STATUS FROM ICOMPORS PORS, ICOMPODT PODT WHERE PORS.BUYER IN ( 'KRCHAN0060', 'KRCHAN0058', 'KRCHAN0059', 'KRDONG0708') AND PORS.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PORS.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PORS.PO_SEQ = PODT.PO_SEQ AND PORS.SEND_FLAG = 'N' AND PODT.PLANT IS NOT NULL AND PODT.PLANT IN ('A0','B0','C0','D0')
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT PODT.PLANT , PRDT.LEGACY_PO_NO , PRDT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ , PODT.REF_IF_NO AS LEGACY_PO_COUNT , to_char(PORS.DS_SEQ,'FM00000') AS DS_SEQ , PORS.BUYER_ITEM_NO , PORS.CD_QTY AS ITEM_QTY , PORS.DS_DATE , ' ' AS NOTE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS IF_DATE , to_char(sysdate,'HH24MISS') AS IF_TIME , PORS.STATUS FROM ICOMPORS PORS, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPRDT PRDT WHERE PORS.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND PORS.PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PORS.PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND PORS.DS_SEQ = '$G_RS.DS_SEQ$' AND PORS.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PORS.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PORS.PO_SEQ= PODT.PO_SEQ AND PORS.SEND_FLAG = 'N' AND PODT.PLANT IS NOT NULL AND PODT.PLANT IN ('A0','B0','C0','D0') AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ= PRDT.PR_SEQ
UPDATE ICOMPORS SET SEND_FLAG = 'Y' , SEND_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , SEND_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND DS_SEQ = '$G_RS.DS_SEQ$'
UPDATE ICOMPORS SET SEND_FLAG = 'E' , SEND_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , SEND_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND DS_SEQ = '$G_RS.DS_SEQ$'
